words.definition: a small thing that takes away pencil marks
words.example: I use a {rubber} to fix my mistakes.

words.definition: school work that you do at home
words.example: Our teacher gives us {homework} every Friday.

words.definition: a time when a teacher teaches you something
words.example: Each {lesson} at our school lasts forty minutes.

words.definition: the school subject about numbers
words.example: In {maths}, we learn to add and take away.

words.definition: the school subject where you draw and paint
words.example: In {art}, we paint pictures of animals.

words.definition: the place outside a school where children play
words.example: The {playground} is where children play at school.

words.definition: the room where you cook food
words.example: Mum is making dinner in the {kitchen}.

words.definition: the room where you sleep
words.example: My bed and my toys are in my {bedroom}.

words.definition: the room with a bath or shower and a toilet
words.example: I have a shower in the {bathroom}.

words.definition: the land next to a house where grass and flowers grow
words.example: Dad grows vegetables in the {garden} behind our house.

words.definition: steps that take you up to the next floor
words.example: Our bedrooms are upstairs, so we climb the {stairs}.

words.definition: the first meal of the day
words.example: I have {breakfast} at seven every morning.

words.definition: the meal you eat in the middle of the day
words.example: At school, we eat {lunch} at twelve o'clock.

words.definition: the meal you eat in the evening
words.example: We have {dinner} together at the end of the day.

words.definition: small white grains that you cook in water and eat
words.example: My curry comes with a bowl of white {rice}.

words.definition: large; not small
words.example: An elephant is a {big} animal.

words.definition: little; not big
words.example: A mouse is a very {small} animal.

words.definition: very warm
words.example: Be careful, the soup is very {hot}!

words.definition: not warm at all, like ice
words.example: In winter, the weather is {cold}.

words.definition: having lived for many years
words.example: My grandpa is eighty years {old}.

words.definition: just bought or made; not old
words.example: These shoes are not old; they are {new}.

words.definition: moving very quickly
words.example: Our car won the race because it is very {fast}.

words.definition: not fast; taking a long time
words.example: The {slow} snail took all day to cross the path.

words.definition: big from one end to the other
words.example: A giraffe has a very {long} neck.

words.definition: not long
words.example: My hair was long, but now it is {short}.

words.definition: feeling good and smiling
words.example: I am so {happy}; I got a new puppy!

words.definition: feeling bad, so you might cry
words.example: I miss my best friend, so I feel {sad}.

words.definition: feeling bad when someone is not fair to you
words.example: Dad was {angry} and shouted, "Who broke the window?"

words.definition: needing to rest or sleep
words.example: I was {tired}, so I went to bed early.

words.definition: wanting to eat
words.example: I am {hungry}, so I want a sandwich.

words.definition: wanting to drink
words.example: I need a drink because I am {thirsty}.

words.definition: afraid that something bad may happen
words.example: My little brother is {scared} of the dark.

words.definition: not interested because there is nothing to do
words.example: I'm {bored}; let's find a fun game to play!

words.definition: a doctor for animals
words.example: We took our sick cat to the {vet}.

words.definition: a big green place in a town where people walk and play
words.example: A {park} is green land in town for everyone.

words.definition: a place with many books that you can take home and bring back
words.example: I take books home from the {library}.

words.definition: a place where you buy things
words.example: We buy bread at the {shop} on the corner.

words.definition: a place where you watch films on a big screen
words.example: We watched a new film at the {cinema}.

words.definition: a place where you can see wild animals
words.example: We saw lions and monkeys at the {zoo}.

words.definition: a place with lots of water where you swim
words.example: I swim up and down in the {swimming pool}.

words.definition: to put food in your mouth
words.example: Cows {eat} grass all day.

words.definition: to take water or milk into your mouth
words.example: When I am thirsty, I {drink} water.

words.definition: to make something clean with water
words.example: Please {wash} your hands before lunch.

words.definition: to have fun with toys or games
words.example: I {play} with my toys in my bedroom.

words.definition: to make music with your voice
words.example: The birds {sing} in the trees every morning.

words.definition: to try to hear something
words.example: Please {listen} to the story I am telling.

words.definition: to look at words and understand them
words.example: I like to {read} books about animals.

words.definition: to look at something for some time
words.example: We {watch} TV in the evening.

words.definition: to move something so that it is not closed
words.example: It's hot in here; please {open} the window.
